title: Fixed Arched Upper Blade and Long Lever Throatless Shear
description: One newly authored whole fixed raised-pose throatless hand-shear-style tabletop tool. One broad chamfered base supports a complete low asymmetric frame with a projecting lower jaw and tall rear pivot shoulder. A whole broad curved upper carrier pivots at that shoulder, carrying a separate full arched blunt metal blade above one complete short straight lower blade; the open interval widens toward the free tips. A full long inclined handle and end grip belong to the upper carrier. One full transverse pivot, proud end retainers, two blade-clamp strips with full fastener heads and a short side hold-down bracket with fixed spindle and blank pad complete the tool. Every visible coordinate is newly authored; no foot-shear frame, blade, sheet-brake apron, notcher or pliers part imported. Unlike the existing wide foot-operated shear, this compact one-sided rear-pivot frame has no full-width table, slotted twin guide towers, treadle or translating cross-carrier. It is not a V-table corner notch press, opposed round-die hammer or handheld scissors. One whole model zero scenes. Blades retain finite blunt thickness, static pose only. No sheet, bar, cutting, sharpened edge, shear-force capacity, moving clearance, gear ratio, clamp action, operating instruction, hand fit, manufacture, engineering or safety claim. Rigging animation and interaction not made.
